Name: Performance Log
Description: Preview. Measures where Timberborn's time and memory go and writes it, session by session, to Documents/Timberborn/PerformanceLog: frame times and where each frame went, the cost of every singleton, kind of entity and mod, garbage collection, saves and loading, with a readme and summary that a person or an AI assistant can use to diagnose slowness. It only observes: it never changes what the game simulates, so it is safe in multiplayer. Slow-frame threshold, window sizes and row limits can be set from the Mod Settings menu.
